title: Checked dynamic array traversal input
summary: Executes either edge of the standard UInt64 traversal guard and the continuing edge's indexed element load while preserving an arbitrary continuation.
premises: A represented UInt64 input array for a continuing edge
Frame getters for the input pointer and encoded traversal index
An in-bounds logical index and a valid item destination local for a continuing edge
An effective stop greater than the current index for a continuing edge, or equal index and stop values for an exit edge
result: The exact emitted guard reaches Break 1 on the exit edge or loads the selected element and reaches an arbitrary continuation on the continuing edge.
